sections.heading: Why Choose It?
sections.text:
Amazonite, Purple Amethyst & Pink Rose Quartz – a balanced mix for calmness, clarity, and emotional support

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 Finish - Smooth, polished beads with a soft, premium shine that feels comfortable on the skin

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 Design - Minimal and versatile design that pairs easily with both casual and everyday outfits

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 Fit - Stretchable elastic band for a snug yet flexible fit on most wrist sizes

sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
How to Wear: You can wear it on your left hand to stay more connected with its calming and emotional balancing energy, or on your right hand if you want to express clarity and confidence outwardly. It works best when worn consistently.
Recharge: Place the bracelet under soft moonlight overnight to refresh its energy. You can also keep it on a selenite plate or near other cleansing crystals to naturally restore its balance. Recharging once every few days or whenever you feel the energy needs a reset is ideal.
Cleanse: Gently wipe the bracelet with a soft, dry cloth to maintain its shine and finish. Avoid using water or harsh chemicals. For energetic cleansing, you can use incense, dhoop, or simply keep it in a calm, clean space to help clear any absorbed negativity.

collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 The 3 Star Gold Chain Crystal Bracelet is designed to bring a sense of balance, calm, and emotional clarity into your everyday life ❤️. Each bead in this bracelet carries its own unique energy, working together to support your thoughts, feelings, and overall mindset.

✨ Amazonite supports calm communication, helping you express your thoughts without overthinking or stress.
✨ Purple Amethyst brings mental clarity and focus, so you can stay steady and make better decisions.
✨ Pink Rose Quartz adds a soft, comforting energy that encourages self-love, emotional healing, and positive relationships.

Together, these three crystals create a balanced flow of energy—helping you stay calm, think clearly, and feel emotionally grounded throughout your day.

Whether you're managing work pressure, navigating personal moments, or just need a sense of inner peace, this bracelet becomes your quiet support system.

Crafted for everyday wear, it is lightweight, comfortable, and effortlessly blends with your style.

This is more than just a bracelet.
It’s a gentle reminder to slow down, stay centered, and move through life with clarity, calmness, and confidence.

This bracelet is carefully handcrafted by skilled artisans and brought to you by India’s biggest crystal home décor brand, ensuring both authenticity and fine detailing.

Made using 100% natural crystals, ensuring the piece carries unique textures, natural variations, and authentic quality, supported by a rigorous multi-step quality testing process.

________________________________________________________________________________________________

✪ Note: Variations in texture, tone, and flow are natural and make every piece one of a kind.

 <div class="

sections.heading: FAQ
sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Q1. What makes this bracelet different from other crystal bracelets?

This bracelet combines three complementary crystals that focus on emotional balance, clarity, and self-connection—making it more holistic rather than targeting just one area.

Q2. Can I wear it during stressful or emotional situations?

Yes, it’s ideal to wear during such moments. It can help you stay calm, think clearly, and respond better instead of reacting impulsively.

Q3. Is it suitable for daily wear?

Absolutely. It is designed to be lightweight, comfortable, and durable for everyday use without feeling heavy on the wrist.

Q4. Can I wear it while working or studying?

Yes, especially because Amethyst supports focus and clarity, making it helpful during work, study, or decision-making tasks.

Q5. Will all bracelets look exactly the same?

No. Since natural crystals are used, slight variations in color, texture, and patterns make each piece unique.

Q6. Can I give this bracelet to someone?

Yes, it makes a thoughtful gift for someone who may need emotional support, clarity, or a reminder to stay balanced.

Q7. Do I need to believe in crystals for it to work?

It works best when worn with intention and consistency, but even otherwise, it can serve as a meaningful reminder to stay calm and centered.
